newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: Town quiet after two Albanians die in riot.
newsitem.headline: Town quiet after two Albanians die in riot.

text.p: Two ethnic Albanians were shot dead and around 400 detained in a mass brawl with police in Macedonia this week, Macedonian radio said on Thursday.

It reported the town of Gostivar calm a day after the rioting there that erupted when police removed the national flag of neighbouring Albania from the town hall under a new law which limits the flying of flags to special occasions.
The radio did not identify the killers of the two men and said at least 53 ethnic Albanians were seriously hurt.
Shop windows in Gostivar were smashed and the streets littered with debris including bullet cases.
Ethnic Albanians are demanding political equality and their own university in Macedonia, where they claim to represent around 40 percent of the population.
The government says census figures show the figure is around 22 percent and Albanian demands for stronger identity are fiercely opposed by Macedonian nationalists.
